Bengaluru Musician Travels to 245 Nations with 16 Passports

A Bengaluru-born musician has gained viral attention for completing a journey to 245 countries, documented across 16 passports filled with stamps and visas. The musician reportedly overcame health struggles during his six-year travel endeavor. His achievement has sparked widespread discussion online.
